title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: Given the heads of two sorted linked lists list1 and list2, merge the two lists into one sorted list and return its head.

hints.content: Use a dummy head node and a tail pointer.
Repeatedly attach the smaller of the two current nodes.

solution.code: function solve(input) { const { list1, list2 } = input; const dummy = { next: null }; let tail = dummy; let a = list1, b = list2; while (a && b) { if (a[0] <= b[0]) { tail.next = a; a = a.next; } else { tail.next = b; b = b.next; } tail = tail.next; } tail.next = a || b; return dummy.next; }
solution.explanation: Merge by repeatedly attaching the smaller head node to a tail pointer, then append any remaining nodes.
